units.title: Replace member authentication with a local account and session boundary
doneWhen: Username and password registration and login contracts are documented
Passwords are hashed and bearer sessions are revocable
Authenticated sessions resolve to the UUID member boundary used by commerce
No external member service or production credential is added
Legacy member sources compile, the existing AuthServiceTest failures are documented, and all Rust verification passes
legacy sources remain unchanged
notes: Local username/password registration, Argon2id password hashing, hashed and revocable 24-hour bearer sessions, and session-to-member UUID resolution are implemented through PostgreSQL and test repository adapters. Rust fmt/check/clippy/test and legacy-clean pass. The legacy AuthServiceTest is preserved unchanged but has three source-baseline failures caused by stale repository stubs and mismatched generated member IDs; this is recorded in the anomaly report.
